children: Yum! Brands Inc. (YUM) filed a Form 8K - Regulation FD Disclosure - with the U.S Securities and Exchange Commission on September 01, 2026.

On September 1, 2026, the Company issued a press release announcing the completion of the Pizza Hut Transaction (as defined below). A copy of the press release is attached hereto as Exhibit 99.1 and is incorporated herein by reference.

The information in this Item 7.01, including Exhibit 99.1, is furnished and shall not be deemed "filed" for purposes of Section 18 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended (the "Exchange Act"), or otherwise subject to liabilities under that section, and shall not be deemed to be incorporated by reference into the filings of the Company under the Securities Act of 1933, as amended or the Exchange Act, regardless of any general incorporation language in such filings.
The full text of this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1041061/000104106126000187/yum-20260901.htm
Any exhibits and associated documents for this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1041061/000104106126000187/0001041061-26-000187-index.htm
Public companies must file a Form 8-K, or current report, with the SEC generally within four days of any event that could materially affect a company's financial position or the value of its shares.
